scope: Finish and saved-result/export validation require a report for sixteen selected targets: seven bond-pad, seven inductor-pad and two implant-enclosure records. The references satisfy conservative absence proofs. Raw purposes, masks and candidate names/labels guard the absence claims; missing enclosures cannot waive present targets. Complete corrected-reference catalog replays now contain 424 executed, 609 absent, 90 W/L exemptions, eight advisories and 425 unreviewed records. All six catalog replays and 57 controls agree across systems; 194 tests pass per OS; three application runs and Windows saved-result/export replays pass. Nonempty target rules, ViaTop, hugePad, generated masks, RF, grid, chip context, pin spacing and density remain unresolved.

application.scope: Actual Runner export removes only the top-level prBoundary box matching the independent OpenDB die. Manufacturing masks and text are compared in full. Six partial geometry profiles, antenna, isolation, OpenDB checks and macro export rerun on the corrected GDS. Original timing/equivalence remains separate; no new extraction, full physical signoff or installer qualification. The retained 45-record core context is supplemented by 37 explicitly absent label, named-cell and raw-layer subjects; present subjects require further review. Four new VPP geometry checks execute, with absent capacitor targets on these references. Density observations do not establish density acceptance. Forty-four new module/seal interaction checks execute. Missing module or seal geometry does not establish complete-chip context. Thirty-six selected device requirements are measured: VPP, pwell resistor and PNP absence requires no drawn markers or candidate names/labels; two implant geometry checks execute with absent targets in these references. Four conservative bounds and eighteen raw IP blockage subjects are freshly checked; failed sufficient bounds and present blockages remain unreviewed. Seven floating-net records are freshly checked against physical device roots, without pin endpoints or exception labels. Seven special-device subject absences require empty relevant drawn/mask operands, merged nwell holes and conservative intent guards; present candidates stay unreviewed. The full corrected reference catalog is replayed separately. Sixteen selected pad, inductor and implant targets are conservatively checked for absence; nonempty targets remain unreviewed.

boundary_export.scope: Remove only the single top-level prBoundary box equal to the OpenDB die, if present. All other forbidden boundary-purpose input is rejected; manufacturing shapes and annotations are preserved.

selected_targets.scope: Sixteen exact catalog targets have conservative absence proofs. BondPad is a subset of pad:drawing under the published C3 definition; the complete drawing and additional pad/mask/intent guards must be empty. The generic pad name must end before another ASCII letter; explicit pad compounds and bond names retain substring matching. These name hints supplement the mandatory raw drawing checks and do not recognize devices by name alone. Every captured inductor family requires the inductor drawing identifier; all identifier/terminal/label data and candidate names must be absent. For r1476, empty poly AND tap implies empty Var_channel and therefore an empty selected well target. For r1493, an absent HVI region makes ndiff inside HVI empty, with additional voltage/mask/intent guards. Missing enclosing metal or implant is never an absence proof. Nonempty or ambiguous targets remain unreviewed. ViaTop, hugePad, other pad variants, generated-mask recipes and device qualification remain separate; no nonempty numerical rule execution is claimed.

special_subjects.scope: Seven catalog obligations have conservative empty-subject proofs only. An entirely absent UHVI region cannot be straddled by any selected geometry. Deep-well enclosure requires the deep-well target itself absent, including explicit mask data. Precision-resistor and RPM-selected subjects require empty RPM, URPM, CRPM and poly-resistor purposes. The nwell-hole angle subject requires no holes in the merged nwell and no explicit nwell mask or extended-drain markers. Candidate cell names or labels prevent the associated proof. Nonempty subjects stay unreviewed; source N/A values are not used as waivers. Nonempty rule meanings and complete device qualification remain separate, including the catalog/manual depmos.8 and urpm.3 naming differences.

device_roots.scope: Every merged routed poly/LI/metal component is traced through every contact level to gate (poly AND diff) or diffusion/tap outside poly. Pin shapes, text, standard-cell markers and exception labels cannot supply endpoints or connectivity. Every submitted conductor/root area must be accounted for. Unrooted components leave the selected catalog messages unreviewed; a legal IP feedthrough is not automatically a foundry violation. Capacitor/RDL/cut/short edits and float/tie declarations prevent this proof. Dummy-fill purposes, device/body correctness, electrical behavior and complete physical qualification remain separate.

conservative_bounds.scope: Four catalog limits are satisfied only when broader drawn-geometry checks pass: all merged NSDM and PSDM widths at least 380 nm, and all merged poly spacing/notches at least 210 nm. No core-gap or opposite-parallel exception is used. A failed sufficient bound is unreviewed, not a claimed violation of the narrower foundry rule. Eighteen IP blockage obligations are absent only when their exact published block purposes contain no raw data. Present blockages remain unreviewed; generated routing operands and hierarchy semantics are not implemented. Generated masks, global grid/density and complete physical coverage remain separate.

selected_devices.scope: Thirty-four VPP, pwell-resistor and PNP catalog records are absent only when their mandatory drawn purpose has no raw shapes and no reachable cell name or label suggests the device. Present candidates remain unreviewed. Separately, each gate (poly AND diff) overlapping tunm must be enclosed by tunm by 95 nm, and every drawn hvntm region must be inside hvi. Gates outside tunm are not selected by this enclosure check; their spacing and device intent remain separate. A SONOS name or label with no gate or with unselected gates keeps r453 unreviewed. Generated implants and complete device/density qualification are not established.

boundary_interactions.scope: Thirty-five published drawn-layer purposes are checked for straddling each supplied module-cut polygon on 81:10. Diffusion is checked for straddling seal 81:1; tap, poly, li1 and met1-met5 are checked for positive-area seal overlap. Targets are merged connected regions. Boundary polygons must be disjoint and non-touching so merging cannot hide an internal boundary. Manhattan polygons and exact orthogonal paths are supported. Missing boundary geometry does not establish chip/frame completeness or waive any enclosure or spacing requirement. Five package-layer scribe records remain separate.

catalog_context.scope: Thirty-three explicitly core-selected geometry messages and one core-approval message require absence of all raw areaid.ce data; three LDNTM messages require absence of the actual implant subject. Present subjects stay unreviewed. Eight boundary prohibitions are checked directly. This is not complete catalog coverage or memory-device qualification.

catalog_labels.scope: Thirty-seven literal catalog messages are resolved only by complete absence of their selected label, named-cell or raw-layer subject. Labels are searched on every purpose and through the hierarchy; case, Unicode compatibility, whitespace and embedded-token variants conservatively prevent absence. Present subjects stay unreviewed. Unmarked floating nets, redundant vias, chip part-number requirements and the construction of module/frame regions remain separate.

vpp_geometry.scope: Selected rules on merged capacitor drawing 82:64: 1.43 um minimum width, no straddling nwell or dnwell, and 1.5 um enclosure for capacitors overlapping nwell. An outside-nwell capacitor leaves the enclosure requirement unreviewed; missing nwell never proves exemption. Manhattan polygons and exact orthogonal paths. Density operands are measured per connected capacitor region without selecting device exceptions or claiming density acceptance. Other VPP rules remain separate.

corrected_attempt.reason: The generic pad substring falsely flagged the four APB paddr labels. Version 2 requires a non-letter after the generic pad token and separately preserves explicit compound-pad and bond hints. Raw guards are unchanged.
corrected_attempt.evidence: The archive retains v1 replay/application records, the failed APB rule reports, original drivers and the exact v1 checker. Version 2 adds 21 retained name controls and two regression tests.

limitations: All sixteen new dispositions are absent-operand; no nonempty numerical pad/implant rule is claimed.
An empty raw drawing alone is insufficient when mask, pin, terminal or device-intent guards are present.
No module or seal geometry is supplied by these blocks; complete-chip context and enclosure obligations remain open.
The full catalog replay is reference-specific; arbitrary jobs require the new target report plus the earlier partial mandatory reports.
Native extraction, nominal voltage, timing and equivalence are retained dependencies. No new electrical run or foundry signoff is claimed.
